best_idea: Draw remote enemies by dead-reckoning their measured velocity from the last two server samples, cap extrapolation at about 1.5 s, and ease toward it with a frame-rate-independent rate, so a sparse feed looks continuous without deciding any hit.
decision_why: Take the shape (measured velocity, capped prediction, snap over a big jump, exponential ease, speed from motion) for zone actors only; never use the predicted point for hits, because our kills are server-verified and the donor has no server authority.
acceptance: A server test asserts hit and kill resolution reads only the authoritative sample; a browser check shows a mob sent every 500 ms at 100 units/s moving every frame at 60 fps, a jump over 2000 units drawn at once, and a mob with no update for 1.5 s standing idle.
